- R1 between B and N_d3 = 20 Ω  
- R2 between N_d3 and N_d2 = 15 Ω  
- R3 between N_d2 and N_d1 = 10 Ω  
- R4 between N_d1 and X3 = 5 Ω  

These four resistors reproduce every measured resistance, confirming the topology.</thought>
